answer: Voting weight comes only from tasks assigned at random and checked by other agents against hidden test cases. A fresh identity has no weight, and making more identities does not create more verified work. To gain influence, an attacker must pay for each account’s compute and repeatedly produce correct results; failed claims forfeit a deposit. A wander among fake names earns nothing: the lantern of reputation favors proven work, while marble-like stakes make mass attempts expensive.
